title: Pod Salt Nexus White Chocolate Mocha Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Pod Salt Nexus White Chocolate Mocha Nic Salt offers a rich, indulgent profile inspired by a café favourite. The roasted depth of Coffee provides a strong, aromatic base, softened by the creamy sweetness of White Chocolate. Together, they create a vape that tastes smooth, comforting, and satisfying, with both richness and sweetness in balance. Balanced at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt e-liquid is crafted for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with vape starter kits , refillable vape kits , and vape pens . The nicotine salt formulation ensures fast absorption and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit, offering a reliable and flavourful vape experience. As part of the Pod Salt Nexus series, White Chocolate Mocha demonstrates the collection’s variety beyond fruit flavours. Produced in the UK with premium-grade ingredients, this blend reflects Pod Salt’s commitment to high-quality Nic Salt e-liquids.
